page.layout: One manuscript page, handwritten in brown ink on ruled lines, with no printed text. Entries run top to bottom in the centre, with a bracket and marks at the left and a short addition at the lower right.
page.notes: This page carries no printed text. It is handwritten annotation (an index or memorandum list in a later hand), so under the rules for printed pages it is left out of the main text. Its legible content, for reference: "Deus. 2 oct. 90." heading; "Precario ad Deum / amuletum contra / pestem. p. 70."; "Iris. 129. Lilium adelste" (rendering uncertain); "AD DEVM."; a bracketed group "Evangeliis ... Platonis" with "Una ass."; "Noctulae ... 90 & 91"; and at the foot "Foi de pistoles ... fidèle ... temps ... non ... pœnitentia ... ad coelum. 209 & 210." Several words are doubtful and are not vouched for.
